summary: Fury Gold Mines Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held June 25, 2026. Shareholders voted to fix the board at six directors, elected all six director nominees, re-appointed PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor, and approved renewal of the long-term incentive plan for three years. Voting tallies are provided, with director support ranging from 72% to 99%. This is a routine meeting results filing under Canadian law, with no special-situation event.
